imagery: Real stock photos in warm interior light: movers in navy uniforms and caps loading cardboard boxes from a cargo van, and warehouse workers with boxes and a tablet. No trucks on highways and no night scenes.
tagline: Moving Freight, Powering Business (eyebrow: Safe, Fast, and Dependable)
design_notes: The mark is a sharp V of navy #002166, black and crimson #db0d3d diagonal speed stripes over wide geometric 'VERTEX TRANSPORTATIONS' lettering. Their documents (Albatross brandbook) use white paper, thin gray rules and #f4f6f9 panels. The live site is a different palette: a dark charcoal Tilda template with gold #e5b64b and Unbounded wide caps. For the email, follow the logo and documents (navy plus crimson on white) and echo the diagonal stripe motif.
